identity.name: bh-28
identity.summary: A merge of pre-trained language models created with mergekit.

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight merge of two language models with no reported evaluations or safety testing -> users may over-trust outputs

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,336 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was created by merging jaspionjader/fr-18-8b and jaspionjader/bh-26 using the SLERP merge method.
training_context.training_data: This checkpoint is a merge of two models, jaspionjader/fr-18-8b and jaspionjader/bh-26, rather than a model trained on a new dataset.
